reviewItems.title: No official fixture or market feed has been verified
reviewItems.detail: No source extracts, accessible OLBG pages, or official sport/competition source records were present in the repository. Live coverage and completeness are therefore unverified.

reviewItems.title: Exclusion definitions need source and scope review
reviewItems.detail: The exclusion names came from the project request. The meaning of football versus American football, and whether UFC/MMA categories overlap, has not been independently resolved.

reviewItems.title: No independently originated lines or picks are published
reviewItems.detail: Current lines, market prices, match facts, and form data cannot be claimed without match-specific official source checks. No predictions have been generated.
